settings.title: TaHoma / Connexoon Settings
settings.intro: To let Homey control TaHoma / Connexoon please authorize Homey, by filling out the TaHoma / Connexoon login credentials.
settings.logout_description: This will logout from Tahoma and remove your credentials from the app.
settings.min_sync_speed: Minimum Sync Speed value is 30 seconds
settings.max_sync_speed: Maximum Sync Speed value is 90 seconds
settings.intro1: Use this if you have a device that is not supported.
settings.intro2: Tap on Get Log and wait for the data to appear. Then tap on Send Log.
settings.intro3: Contact @Adrian_Rockall on the community forum to describe which device is not supported.
settings.intro4: No personal data is captured or sent so if you don't contact me via a GitHub issue or the Forum I will not be able to respond.
settings.intro5: Local tokens are used to access the Somfy hub over the local network
settings.use_local: Connect directly to the hub via the local network
settings.polling_enabled: Poll Somfy cloud for status updates
settings.confirm_send_device_log: Send the device log contents to the developer?
settings.confirm_send_info_log: Send the error log contents to the developer?
settings.confirm_send_event_log: Send the event log contents to the developer?
settings.log_sent_with_id_prefix: Log sent successfully. Please contact @Adrian_Rockall on the forum with the log ID:
settings.enter_token_uuid_to_delete: Enter a token UUID to delete
settings.driver_support_fetch_failed: Failed to fetch driver support data
settings.driver_support_connect_login: Please save your login credentials in the settings tab to connect to your account
settings.driver_support_supported_not_added: Supported but not added to Homey
settings.driver_support_supported_added: Supported and already added to Homey
settings.driver_support_no_matching_devices: No Somfy devices were available for matching.
